planets.name: Kepler-138 e
planets.description: Planet of Kepler-138 found by transit timing variations, with a 38.2-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: Kepler-138 e was found in 2022 by transit timing variations; it does not cross its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around Kepler-138. Its orbit, tilt included, follows Piaulet et al. 2023's fit, and its size is the archive's model from its mass.
